name: Connector — DVI
description: Through-hole DVI-D and DVI-I dual-link connectors (Molex 74320-4004 and 74320-1004 horizontal footprints) for PC video/monitor interface connections.
selection_hints: Choose DVI-D for digital-only links; choose DVI-I if analog RGB pins are also needed.
Match the exact Molex footprint (74320-4004 vs 74320-1004) to the intended land pattern.
Prefer the tier A representative parts, which have exact footprint matches.
avoid_when: The board needs a connector footprint other than the two Molex horizontal patterns listed.
Electrical ratings or pin assignments are required but not stated by the selected part.
A vertical or right-angle mounting orientation different from the listed horizontal footprint is needed.
